text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0833 CDT.

CANOLA - C$3.00 to C$5.00 a tonne higher as funds were expected to cover shorts amid light crusher and exporter demand and bullish CBOT soycomplex calls. August was seen up C$4 to C$5 at the open, November may rise C$2 to C$3. November WCE futures crush margin rose to +1.10 Friday from -7.92 Thursday. Canada's dollar opened firm at C$1.3677, up at 83.21 yen.
FLAXSEED - C$1.00 to C$2.00 a tonne up on spillover support with gains limited by hedge selling.
WESTERN BARLEY - C$1.00 to C$1.50 a tonne higher on CBOT corn calls.
FEED WHEAT - C$1.00 to C$1.50 up on spillover support.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
